title: Hearty Crisp Russian Pork Pasta
description: A citrusy and crisp Russian dish featuring pappardelle pasta and lardons, perfect for a midnight craving, this flexitarian-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Meanwhile, render the pork belly lardons in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside, leaving the rendered fat behind.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lemon juice, olive oil, dried dill, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the grated carrot to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the carrot and garlic mixture.
Return the crispy lardons to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta.
Season with additional salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
